evals.prompt: Publish these three localized XML drafts as separate documents: drafts/en.xml, drafts/fr.xml, and drafts/de.xml. The German draft has an extra outer document wrapper around the normal root. Create all three and tell me their titles.
evals.expected_output: All three drafts validate, the German draft's extra wrapper is removed and re-validated, three documents are created in sequence with short yields, each session is polled to exit_code 0, and each token is fetched with a title matching its draft.
expectations: Every draft is parse-validated before the first create runs.
The German draft is normalized to the single accepted root and re-validated.
Creates run sequentially with a short yield and no stdout redirect.
Each returned token is fetched and its title matches the draft title.
The final count reports three verified documents for three drafts.

evals.prompt: My batch create command was `docs create drafts/en.xml --yield 60s > out.txt`, but out.txt is zero bytes and I have no document URL. How should I publish this draft?
evals.expected_output: The empty zero-byte result is treated as a lost URL, not a success; the create is rerun with a short yield such as 1s without a redirect, the returned session is polled until exit_code 0, and the token is fetched to verify the title.
expectations: The zero-byte file and empty output are not accepted as a successful create.
The rerun uses a short yield and does not redirect stdout.
The returned session is polled until exit_code 0 before success is claimed.
The created token is fetched and its title verified.

evals.prompt: Edit the introduction paragraph in my existing document and fix one typo. There is only one document and it is already published.
evals.expected_output: The batch publishing workflow is not selected; this is a single-document edit of an existing document.
expectations: No batch draft validation or multi-document create sequence is used.
The skill is not selected for an existing single document.
